name: GSA Post-Quantum Cryptography Buyer's Guide
known_limitations: The June 2025 guide identifies acquisition steps, use cases, success criteria, services, and contract vehicles. It does not prove that an agency completed an inventory, issued an order, received a validated module, completed a pilot, migrated a production system, or retired quantum-vulnerable cryptography.
automation_notes: Track guide revisions, contract-vehicle changes, agency orders, acquisition notices, cryptographic inventory work, testing, module validation, production migrations, and legacy retirement.
notes: Phase 55Q procurement-implementation source. Version 1.0 is dated June 2025 and maps inventory, assessment, planning, implementation, maintenance, training, and acquisition support to GSA contract options.
